description: Read the Signals Quick Reference guide when the user asks for that guide or its documented entries. This is the document-reading shortcut for kb_get_document slug=10-signals-quick-reference, not an additional validation step. Use view=overview for its outline or view=section with a known anchor for a passage. Content defaults to 6000 characters; offset and next_offset count characters within the selected body. Continue only for requested missing text. Reserve full=True for explicit downloads. For conceptual signal combinations use query_knowledge op=ask. For executable signal names and parameters needed to construct a strategy use the runtime catalogue, not this educational guide.

full.description: Explicit full content download; cannot combine with offset or max_chars.

max_chars.description: Page size, default 6000, capped at 12000 and the response budget.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

section_anchor.description: Exact anchor from overview or search, required only for section view.

view.description: Use overview for a brief summary and headings; section for a specific topic; content for document pages.

name: kb_get_signal_quick_reference
